games.name: Randomly Generated Droids
games.desc:
1.15 is out with three new classes: the Recycler, the Ronin, and the Jeweler!

Randomly Generated Droids is a procedurally-generated roguelike focused heavily on sword-fighting mechanics. Every run is different from the last: face several different Droids as you continually get stronger.

🤖 Battle over fifty enemy varieties as you travel through a series of fleshed-out worlds! 
🎓 Various classes to unlock and purchase, with each directly influencing how you play the game!
⚔️ Over fifty weapons and a hundred items to experiment with as you fight your way to the end!
👥 You can play this game solo, or you can play with a party of up to four people!
📈 Is the game somehow too easy for you? Stack up ascension levels for a challenge!

Join the RGD Fans! group here: https://www.roblox.com/groups/5398551

games.name: [QOL] Left 4 Blox
games.desc:
[L4B]

"Left 4 Blox" is a chaotic versus zombie game featuring a variety of unique gamemodes, weapons, perks & maps. As a Survivor, your goal is to work together with your team and stay alive until the timer runs out; survival is your only path to victory. As an infected, your objective is to hunt down and eliminate all survivors before time runs out.

Game Keybinds for PC and Console can be found in-game settings; as well offering a support for you to customize them however you want.
For Mobile users you can as well customize them by choosing the size and where you want them to be.
You can find the options in: Settings > UI

Vote-Kick Command:
/votekick PlayerName, Reason (exploit, afk)
- There's requirements you have to met in order to use this feature.

This project is fully and heavily inspired by Left 4 Dead 2, a game developed by Valve.
We are still progressing in the game development since it's not fully finished. Expect bugs to happen, any bug report sent will be appreciated.

games.desc:
🔥 Welcome to Melt The Ice! 🧊

Are you ready to melt your way through the cold? Grab powerful fire weapons, melt through frozen stages, increase your Fire Power, and make it to the end before you freeze!

[How To Play]
• 🔥 Use your weapon to melt the ice!
• 💪 Keep firing to increase your Fire Power!
• 🧊 Break through harder and harder frozen stages!
• 🧥 Upgrade your gear to survive colder areas!
• 🏆 Reach the end, earn Wins, and become stronger!

Can you melt through every stage without freezing? ❄️
